name: Vercel AI Gateway
description: Unified gateway with no token markup, including $5 of free credit each month per team.
overview: Vercel AI Gateway is a unified OpenAI-compatible API for hundreds of models with no token markup. Every Vercel team gets $5 of free credit per month, usable on Free Tier eligible models at lower per-model rate limits, and a few models are priced at $0 outright. Buying credits moves the team to the paid tier and ends the monthly credit.
free_access: $5 free credit per team per month

notes: The monthly credit stops once AI Gateway credits are purchased; free models are rate-limited below the paid tier.
